method: Copy the public numbers into empty named fields, inspect corresponding digits from the highest place until the first difference, then choose a comparison sign.
invariants: No number is prefilled in a help frame.
Only checked prior student entries are later references.
Existing generator bounds, public signatures and answer schemas remain unchanged.
All three signs are choices, with incorrect choices rejected; final answers are not transferred to the main question.
Old drafts reset; checked partial drafts serialize and restore.
supply: 2000 normal-generator questions preserve the original 100..10000 domain and contain at least 100 distinct public signatures. Boundary/equal/zero cases are separate engine tests, not injected native questions.
limits: Tests do not establish learner comprehension, physical-device/tablet behavior or release readiness.
